observations.text: Official manual: PRC-34 contains exactly four ordered transitions, stages 1 through 4; each stage output becomes the next stage input.
In PRC-34 stage 1, BEX-85 changes into FAR-59.
In PRC-34 stage 2, FAR-59 changes into NIX-55.
In PRC-34 stage 4, ZUM-95 changes into terminal marker RAV-81.

In PRC-20 stage 4, BIR-56 changes into terminal marker NIX-62.

In PRC-80 stage 2, XAN-46 changes into GOL-51.
In PRC-80 stage 4, CYN-80 changes into terminal marker VOR-14.
